lines.en: : I’m...sorry to bother you, but...I’m pretty sure it’s...um...judgement day...
: Judgement day?
: Sorry, um...that...probably wasn’t the...best explanation of...the...uhh...
: Can we maybe...go somewhere more...private?...
: I think if...we’re alone, I...I’ll be able to...explain what it is I...
: Sana, you can just tell me this is for the confession contest, you know. Uta and Imani just had a whole speech about the order of events for the rest of the day.
: Y-Yeah, but...that doesn’t make it any...easier for me to...you know...talk about it and...and confessions are...supposed to be a more...p...private thing in general...right?
: Probably. I’m not really one to confess my feelings, though. But I guess there was that one time in the inn yesterday...
: The inn?...
: Long story. I’ll tell you when you’re older.
: Do you...
: Do you want to take...me to the...inn?...
: The way you said that is setting off several alarms in my head that I am legally obligated to inform you of.
: Alarms?...What do you mean?...
: I mean that you are already beginning to rack up points even though you haven’t started your confession yet.
: I can...maybe...come back to your room if...if that’s what you-
: You know what? How about we go somewhere else that isn’t a dark, confined space?
: Wha-
: But that’s...hold on...I’m okay with-
: Yeah, you’re too okay with it. To the point where I no longer trust myself.
: S-Sensei! Wait!
Sana and I (But mostly just I) begin to make our way down the coast in an effort to protect her body from being split in half by my massive penis.
Well, I’m sure that isn’t the specific reason floating around in her head, but with the way she was holding my sleeve and staring up at me just a few seconds ago, it’s absolutely what’s in mine.
But that’s why I’m doing this. I need to get better at only thinking of terrible things in situations where I won’t contaminate anyone else.
I should call Niki again. I can take my feelings out on her.
Or Nodoka.
No. Not Nodoka. Niki.
Nodoka is not someone I should take my feelings out on.
No matter how much she wants me to.
No matter how evil those feelings are.
No matter how much I want to take them out on her.
No matter how much I want to puke in her mouth.
: Oh. We’re here now.
: What do you mean now?...I’ve been...chasing after you for...half an hour...
: I’m losing a lot of...valuable...confession time...
: Sorry. I know you’re just trying to win to appease the rest of the girls on your floor, but I should still let you get whatever it is you’ve been preparing off your chest. It’s only fair.
: Why would you say it like that?...
: I didn’t mean for that to be offensive. You’ve just never really seen me the way the others do and I’d be an idiot to not understand that by now.
: What you want is a teacher who doesn’t look at you like a piece of meat, but as an actual girl with real feelings and thoughts and-
: You shouldn’t...pretend to...know what other people want...
: And...um...even if that was true...I still have to...give you my confession, so...
: But it’ll be a fake one.
: Right?
: Sensei...
: Why didn’t you take me to the inn?...
: What?
: Are you not as...interested in me as...the rest of-
: Sana, it’s the exact opposite of that. I took you here because I am interested in you.
: But I...don’t understand what’s...so different about being here...
: We’re still alone and...you could do...
: Like...umm...anything you wanted and...no one would...
: No one would...catch you...
: You know exactly what you’re doing right now, don’t you?
: No.
: This was your plan from the start, wasn’t it? You wanted to appeal to my dark side with your innocent, angelic charm.
: I’m not really as...much of an angel as...you...think I am...

: There it is again. I didn’t know you had it in you, Sana. Especially since this is supposed to be a “love” confession and not a more lewd one that will just lead me to believing you actually want me.
: I...don’t know what...you’re talking about...
: What if I actually did take you back to the inn? How far would you have taken this?
: Nowhere in...particular...
: How badly did I screw up your gameplan by coming here instead? You were probably banking on being in a dark room, weren’t you?
: There...wasn’t really a plan, I just...things kind of...you know...like this...
: Do you remember your old bathing suit?
: And your giant hoodie.
: I...still wear that...sometimes, but...why do you...
: You just used to be so different. You were always self-conscious about showing off too much of your body around me.
: And now here you are, in a bathing suit that can barely even be called a bathing suit, intentionally turning me on for the sake of a competition.
: The old Sana never would have done something like this. She would have just started yelling and crying and...sprinted off or something.
: And the old Sensei would have...been a lot more perverted and...actually gone along with...the many hints I have...been dropping...
: You’re right. He probably would have.
: We’ve both...changed a lot...haven’t we?...
: I’d say that’s a fair assessment, yes.
: Do you like the...new me, or...the old me more?...
: I appreciate all Sanas equally. But now, I’d like to ask you the same question in regard to the different versions of me. Do you have a preference?
: They both...have their share of benefits, but...
: I do like how...you can...understand a little more about me now than...you used to be able to...
: S-Still not...everything, though...
: No one understands everything about anyone.
: But there are some people who...want to learn more while...others start...to slow down...and I...
: I, umm...I want to...learn more...about you...
: Is this you pivoting to a more innocent confession after being caught in the midst of the sexier one?
: I...I don’t really know...I was being serious when I said there...wasn’t a gameplan...
: I just...you’re...umm...
: Just tell me you like me and I’ll let you forget all about the misleading stuff you were saying a few minutes ago.
: Are you...going to...forget all that stuff too?...
: Absolutely not. These memories will be following me to bed whether I like it or not.
: Okay...yeah...
: Do you ever...like...
: You know...
: To me...
: Are you asking what I think you’re asking right now?
: No. Probably not.
: I don’t know.
: Do y-
: Yes.
: Oh, look. A rock.
: What do you mean, “Oh, look. A rock?” You can’t just walk away on that note.
: I...can do whatever I want!
Sana slaps her cheeks before hopping onto a rock that adds about another foot to her height.
But when I approach her, I realize that not even that can make her taller than me.
And as she inches closer, bringing her body a mere foot from mine, I am overcome with the urge to lift her up and do exactly what she was alluding to moments ago.
No one would catch me. I could have my way with her and leave her propped up against a tree, unable to walk after being torn to shreds by my desire to have her.
For a moment, I dream of keeping her locked away in my room like a pet — where she would subsist for as long as possible on a diet of only cum and the leftovers of whatever Ami cooks at night.
Eventually, she would die.
It may take a long time, and she would have plenty of exercise in the process.
But she would die.
Because no one can live like that.
: Sensei...
: ...Yeah?
: Remember a long time ago when I told you I only saw you as a teacher?
: Yes. And it pains me to this day.
: Well...
: What if that’s something that’s changed about me too?
: Is this still part of the-
: You’ll never know!
: Sana? Where are you-
: Secret!
: What the...
: Hello?
: Yo.
: Nice timing. Your competitor just wandered off.
: Rad. That means you can make your way over here so I can get my whole spiel out of the way and go back to doing other stuff.
: Reluctance and a desire to get this over with. Good start to a confession, Otoha.
: Oh, come on. You’re dreading this too and you know it.
: I will never dread attention from an attractive girl who may or may not actually like me and is probably just pretending to.
: Hey, don’t be so hard on yourself. I think you’re a mostly acceptable dude like 35%% of the time.
: And the other 65%%?
: The other 65%% of the time I’m probably just not even thinking about you.
: You might think that sounds like an insult, but I’m going to silently enjoy the implication that you spend over a third of your life thinking about me.
: At the risk of making it sound as if I like you any more than that, can you just get the fuck over here already?
: Where is here? And why don’t you just come to-
: Boom. Just shared my location. And please don’t tell me your senior-citizen brain hasn’t grasped how GPS works yet because I really don’t want to spend my afternoon teaching you.
: This is the most passive aggressive confession I have ever received.
: It’ll be better in person.
: Trust me.
I hang up the phone.
And I come back to a life in a place far brighter than the last.
The girl standing before me is taller this time — and I have less of a desire to leave her sweaty and propped up against a tree as I hurry away and look over my shoulder.
But this girl is different in a number of ways that I can’t help but be attracted to.
Or perhaps...entranced by is a better description as her distaste for me seems genuine and not the side-effect of how tsundere girls are an actual real thing I have to deal with on a daily basis.
Otoha is no tsundere. She’s just...Otoha, I guess.
Which makes me all the more concerned about how this confession is going to play out.
: Yo. Welcome to the fabled beach confession spot. My name’s Otoha and I really don’t want to do this.
: My name’s Akira. But I guess that’s a thing you already know since you spilled it to both Nodoka and Rin the other day.
: Which you should thank me for since it allowed you to have sex with my roommate without remaining anonymous. And knowing who you’re boning makes the whole thing a lot better, doesn’t it?
: Says you.
: We weren’t too loud on the other side of the wall, were we?
: I didn’t hear a single noise from you. Now, Rin on the other hand...
: Years of sexual repression, gone in an instant. I’d have probably been loud too.
: Were you jealous? That it was me who got her to make those noises and not you?
: Hey, when does the confession start? I’m on a tight schedule here.
: Oh yeah? Who’s it gonna be tonight? Nodoka again? Maybe Futaba this time?
: You’re not trying to blackmail me into choosing you over Sana, are you?
: Is that how it sounds?
: That’s kind of how it sounds.
: Hmmmmmm........
: No. That’s not what I’m gonna do.
: Because, contrary to popular belief, I actually do like you.
: Just only 35%% of the time.
: No, I like you about 85%% of the time. There’s just a weird extra 50%% in there where I like you in spite of how unacceptable you are as a human being.
: Go on...
: You want more? That was all I prepared for today. I was kind of hoping that would be enough.
: If Sana hadn’t come up with a brilliant sneak attack, it might have been.
: What’d she do, exactly? Gathering some ideas this late in the game might not be the best strategy, but if it’s something I can handle, I might as well go for it.
: You can start by blushing and then looking away before proceeding to say a whole bunch of misleading stuff that alludes to the possibility of the two of us having sex.
: Yeah, I’m not gonna do that.
: I figured as much.
: But what I will do is recite to you a series of words that was definitely written for you and not anyone else.
: And while it may seem like some of this is directed toward another person, I would like to clarify that is most certainly not the case and that these are all of the feelings I have for you.
: Convincing.
: Akira Arakawa.
: Otoha Okakura.
: You’re one of the coolest people I have ever met.
: If I didn’t believe you a minute ago, I do now. This is very clearly about me.
: Do you struggle when it comes to being humble? Absolutely. Are you way older than someone I should want to spend my time with? Again, absolutely.
: Do you have attitude problems? A damn near crippling superiority complex? And so much raw talent that it’s utterly sickening? Again, abso-fucking-lutely.
: Okay. This is starting to sound less like me the more it goes on.
: I fucking suck when it comes to love. I don’t get it. I’m not particularly interested in it. And I don’t even think it’s necessary most of the time.
: These are things you probably shouldn’t be saying as someone in a relationship.
: For the sake of this fake confession, please just pretend that relationship doesn't exist.
: That being said, there is no one else on this planet I would rather spend my time with than you.
: But why-
: Because I’m not sure if anyone else will ever really get me.
: When you’re in a relationship, there’s this pressure to always be by each other’s side and stuff like that. But with you, I feel like that wouldn’t exist.
: We could both have our own things...and function as our own people. I could write music and practice my vocals, and you could play as many sold-out shows as you want in between our meetings.
: I could...what?
: Oh, sorry. The Sensei I dreamt up for the sake of this confession just also happens to be a musician.
: Uhh...
: Don’t pay it any mind. The point is, the kind of relationship I could have with you is one I’d never tire of.
: Mix that with the fact that you’re incredibly hot and mature and that you evoke feelings in me that I can not repeat out loud and you’ve got a recipe for success, man.
: So how about you and me blow this fuckin’ popsicle stand and you can go and make a woman out of me?
: You don’t actually mean that, do you?
: No! I don’t actually mean that!
: Otoha, what is this?
: It’s mostly just me venting to the one person who I think I can vent to because if we both know secrets about each other, neither one of us will spill them. Probably.
: Okay. But I can’t say any of this has really been a secret worth spilling just yet, so you still have the upper hand.
: Oh 100%%. And none of my secrets could even come close to all of the fucked up shit you’ve done. But, as someone on the complete opposite side of things, I have a question for you.
: Do you think it’s worth it?
: Or, I guess a better way of wording that question is...do you think it’s worth completely trashing your image in pursuit of something you’ve always wanted?
: Which, in your case, happens to be teenage vagina.
: No. No, I don’t think it’s worth it.
: Can you tell me it is so I can have the last push I need to make the metaphorical voices in my head stop screaming so loudly all the fucking time?
: The “Sensei you dreamt up” was never actually me, was it?

: See? This is why I like you. You get it. You just also suck. But a thing I’ve realized recently is that I suck too. So I need to be around other people who suck to rationalize that and move past it.
: Is this about hitting Rin? Because she seemed fine with it and, as long as it doesn’t happen again, I think it’s possible to move past-
: It’s about me cheating on her.
: You what?
: Hey, don’t go making that face when you’re cheating on everybody. I get that I fucked up and I don’t need an even bigger fuck-up reminding me of that.
: Who did you-
: What should I do? Keep hiding it the way you do? Tell her?
: And, in regard to the person I cheated on her with, what comes next? They don’t seem to like me that way, but like...I can’t stop thinking about them.
: When did you first realize you liked younger girls, by the way? Was it, like...always a thing? Or is this a more recent development for you?
: You good?
: Yeah. Just kind of shocked.
: Yeah. I’m going through some shit right now too.
: It might seem like I’m all cool and collected and whatnot, but I’m kind of dying on the inside and it’s getting pretty fucking scary.
: When you say you cheated-
: It was just a kiss. Like, a small one. I got caught up in the moment. I think. Maybe. Or maybe I was looking for a moment. I don’t know.
: I just know that it happened and I don’t know who to talk to about it since my closest friends are all Rin’s friends. And Nodoka will just put it in her fucking book.
: Do you...actually trust me enough to tell me this, Otoha? Because I haven’t given you a single reason to do that.
: I don’t think I have a choice.
: You’re like a...stupid little brother to me and I just don’t have anyone else to turn to.
: Little brother...
: Yeah. I guess it’s kind of weird since you’re clearly the older one. By like...a lot. And I’m not all that mentally mature myself yet.
: But I feel like you’re always doing so much stupid shit that I have to look out for you and...
: Akira?...
: Let’s call it here, Otoha.
: Can we talk later then? I really do need someone to just, like...vent to.
: Vent?
: Yeah. That’s...cool, right?
/////////SeCtIoNrEdAcTeD
: Thanks for having that talk with me, Sensei. I’m glad I went with my gut instead of reading the actual confession Rin and I came up with.
: And by “Rin and I” I mean mostly Rin. Who totally wanted your dick before I swooped in and started fingering her.
